polityNote: Republic of Yemen (unified 1990-05-22); the de jure governorate layout is used, not the wartime control lines after 2014. Atoms: geoBoundaries YEM ADM2 (333 districts + 2 Socotra districts, OCHA/Central Statistical Organization, CC BY 3.0 IGO, 2021); district → governorate by the gb ADM1 point test (all 335 fall in exactly one governorate). Rewritten from the Natural Earth dossier so that Socotra (two whole districts) separates from Hadramawt in 2013.
